text: so, im curious, what is the traced path an edit makes when it happens. it sounds like it goes da da -> da da -> da da -> da da -> da da for each edit, but at which step does it fuck up
resolution: Answered the follow-up on req_3469's assessment: traced the exact step-by-step path an edit takes through the host (drag path: 5-step in-place fan-out inside one Zig call, applyTransform through applyMeshMutation/patchActiveEditMesh — effectively safe; topology path: 4-step atomic rebuild inside replaceActiveEditMesh, then a 4-listener fan-out where every documented failure lives: JS key adoption, part-range mirror with silent refusal gates, doc-twig re-stamp, GPU re-intern into the never-evicting retained buffer). Conclusion delivered to user: the chain never breaks mid-mutation in Zig; it breaks in the notification leg after the op returns, because four independent consumers must each notice the new mesh generation and nothing verifies they all did. No code changed — explanation only.
